pages.title: Fox Face with Upright Pointed Ears and Fluffy Cheek Tufts Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox face fills this printable coloring page, with upright pointed ears, large eyes, a small triangular nose, and layered tufts along both cheeks. The centered portrait leaves wide spaces across the forehead and muzzle, with finer sections inside the ears. This coloring sheet focuses entirely on the face without surrounding scenery.

pages.title: Sleeping Fox Curled Beneath Fern Fronds with Its Tail Around Its Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a sleeping fox curled beneath arching fern fronds, its eyes closed and its thick tail tucked around its nose. Small stones, leaves, and grass surround the resting animal. The coloring sheet contrasts the fox's broad curled shape with the many narrow leaflets overhead and delicate fur marks.

pages.title: Baby Fox Peeking Out of a Woodland Den Coloring Page
pages.description: A baby fox peeks from a woodland den in this printable coloring page, sitting beneath a rounded entrance with oversized ears and a fluffy chest. Leaves sprout around the opening, and small stones lie beside its front paws. The coloring sheet offers broad fur sections framed by the den's uneven contours and leafy details.

pages.title: Mother Fox Nuzzling Her Kit Beside Their Den Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a mother fox nuzzling her kit beside their den, with touching noses, pointed ears, and long tails resting near their paws. A rounded burrow entrance and scattered grass sit behind the pair. The coloring sheet gives the two foxes most of the space, with smaller fur tufts around their cheeks and chests.

pages.title: Two Fox Kits Gently Wrestling on the Grass Beside Tree Roots Coloring Page
pages.description: Two fox kits wrestle beside tree roots in this printable coloring page, with one standing over its playmate and their raised paws meeting above the grass. The lower kit rolls onto its back, showing small paw pads, while both bushy tails curve around the scene. This coloring sheet includes fine fur edges and simple patches of grass.

pages.title: Fox Family Resting Together Inside an Underground Den Beneath Tree Roots Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox family rests beneath tree roots in this printable coloring page, with two adults curled around two sleeping kits inside a rounded underground den. Their closed eyes and overlapping tails form the center of the composition. Exposed roots and scattered pebbles frame the coloring sheet, adding small details around the foxes' larger body shapes.

pages.title: Mother Fox Leading Three Kits Through Tall Meadow Grass Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a mother fox leading three kits through tall meadow grass, turning her head toward them as they follow close behind. Pointed ears and fluffy chest fur distinguish each fox among the long blades. The coloring sheet pairs large animal shapes with dense, narrow grass sections across the foreground.

pages.title: Mother Fox Gently Carrying a Small Kit By the Scruff Toward Their Den Coloring Page
pages.description: A mother fox carries her kit by the scruff in this printable coloring page, stepping toward a den while the little fox's paws hang beneath it. The adult's long tail curves behind her, and grass borders the burrow entrance. This coloring sheet includes broad fur areas, small paws, and scattered stones along the ground.

pages.title: Red Fox Standing on a Mossy Fallen Log Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a red fox standing on a mossy fallen log, with upright ears, a long bushy tail, and its head turned aside. Leafy stems and a tree trunk rise around the horizontal log. Bark lines, patches of moss, and fine fur tufts give the coloring sheet smaller sections around the fox's open body shapes.

pages.title: Red Fox Running Along a Winding Forest Path Coloring Page
pages.description: A red fox runs along a winding forest path in this printable coloring page, lifting its paws beneath a fluffy chest and a high curved tail. Tall trunks frame the trail, with bushes and tufts of grass along its edges. The coloring sheet keeps the running fox prominent while adding smaller stones and foliage around its route.

pages.title: Fox Leaping Across a Narrow Woodland Stream Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a fox leaping across a narrow woodland stream, its body stretched between grassy banks and its bushy tail held high. Smooth rocks border the water, and leafy trees frame the jump. The coloring sheet provides large spaces on the fox's body alongside thin ripples, bark marks, and small leaves.

pages.title: Fox Drinking From the Edge of a Forest Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox drinks at a forest pond in this printable coloring page, lowering its muzzle to circular ripples beside a grassy bank dotted with stones. Its long tail hangs behind while leafy branches and distant conifers fill the background. This coloring sheet includes broad fur areas, narrow grass blades, and small enclosed leaves around the water.

pages.title: Fox Digging a Burrow in a Sandy Woodland Bank Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a fox digging a burrow into a sandy woodland bank, scraping loose earth with its front paws beside the rounded opening. Exposed roots run through the slope, and small stones scatter below the fox. The coloring sheet mixes the animal's large body and raised tail with finer soil marks and leafy plants.

pages.title: Fox Eating Ripe Blackberries From a Low Bramble Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox eats blackberries from a low bramble in this printable coloring page, holding its muzzle beside a berry cluster while standing with its tail lowered. Serrated leaves and branching stems carry more fruit beside its paws. This coloring sheet contrasts the fox's broad fur sections with the small round shapes making up each blackberry.

pages.title: Fox Standing Still with Its Ears Raised to Listen Beneath the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a fox listening beneath the snow, standing still with raised pointed ears and its head angled toward the winter ground. Snow-covered fir trees and gentle drifts surround its narrow legs and hanging tail. The coloring sheet uses open snowy areas around the fox, with smaller branches and fur tufts to color.

pages.title: Fox Pouncing Headfirst Into a Deep Snowdrift Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox pounces headfirst into a deep snowdrift in this printable coloring page, with its hind legs lifted and its large bushy tail sweeping upward. Scattered snow clumps surround the spot where its head disappears. The coloring sheet leaves wide open spaces across the snow and fox's body, edged with pointed fur tufts.

pages.title: Fox Following a Trail of Animal Footprints Across a Snowy Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows a fox tracking animal footprints across a snowy clearing, with its head lowered, one paw lifted, and its tail extended behind. Several winding trails of paw prints cross the open ground. Snowy fir trees and distant drifts frame the coloring sheet without filling the large white spaces around the fox.

pages.title: Arctic Fox Standing on Snowy Tundra Beside an Icy Rock Coloring Page
pages.description: An Arctic fox stands beside an icy rock in this printable coloring page, showing a thick chest ruff, upright ears, and a full tail curved behind it. Icicles hang from the snow-capped stone near its paws. The coloring sheet places the fox against simple snowdrifts, leaving broad areas between the smaller fur and ice details.

pages.title: Arctic Fox Mother Watching Her Kits Outside a Rocky Den Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features an Arctic fox mother watching two kits outside a rocky den, with the little foxes looking up beside her curled tail. Angular stones form the large entrance behind the family. Rounded faces and fluffy chest outlines stand out on the coloring sheet, with a few rocks and grass tufts below.

pages.title: Arctic Fox Exploring Summer Tundra Covered with Wildflowers Coloring Page
pages.description: An Arctic fox explores flowering summer tundra in this printable coloring page, lowering its head toward blossoms while stepping across gently rolling ground with scattered leaves. Low hills stretch behind the fox, and larger flowers fill the foreground. This coloring sheet combines open body areas with smaller petals, narrow stems, and leafy patches.

pages.title: Fennec Fox with Oversized Ears Standing Beside Its Desert Burrow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a fennec fox beside its desert burrow, with oversized pointed ears, slim front legs, and a long tail hanging behind it. Low dunes rise above the rounded entrance, with sparse grass and small stones below. The coloring sheet emphasizes the fox's huge ears and leaves the surrounding sand mostly open.

pages.title: Fennec Fox Resting in the Shade Beneath a Sandstone Ledge Coloring Page
pages.description: A fennec fox rests beneath a sandstone ledge in this printable coloring page, its front paws extended and its bushy tail curled beside its folded legs. Layered rock lines form an overhang above the fox's large ears. This coloring sheet offers broad spaces on the animal, with smaller stone cracks, pebbles, and sparse desert grass.

pages.title: Fennec Fox Family Exploring Sand Dunes Beneath a Crescent Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a fennec fox family exploring sand dunes beneath a crescent moon, with one adult leading two smaller foxes in a line. Their large ears and lifted tails stand out against the open sky. The coloring sheet uses smooth dune curves and broad white areas around the three walking animals.

pages.title: Gray Fox Climbing the Trunk of a Low Branching Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A gray fox climbs a low branching tree in this printable coloring page, bracing its paws against the sloping trunk with its head angled toward the leaves. Its long tail hangs below the climbing pose, beside detailed bark lines and knots. This coloring sheet includes broad animal sections framed by narrow branches, grass, and small stones.

pages.title: Swift Fox Standing Beside a Burrow in Open Prairie Grassland Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a swift fox beside a prairie burrow, standing among sparse grass tufts with pointed ears and its head turned toward the viewer. A low horizon stretches behind the fox and rounded entrance. The coloring sheet leaves large open areas across the grassland while adding smaller paw, ear, and fur details.

pages.title: Kit Fox Walking Across Sandy Desert Ground Between Scattered Rocks Coloring Page
pages.description: A kit fox walks between scattered desert rocks in this printable coloring page, lifting one front paw beneath its slim body and tall pointed ears. Its full tail trails behind, with small pebbles and a few grass blades nearby. This coloring sheet offers broad spaces on the fox and angular enclosed sections across the larger stones.

pages.title: Bat-eared Fox Listening for Insects in Short Grass Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a bat-eared fox listening for insects in short grass, bending its head toward a grasshopper with its enormous ears raised. Its paws stand among small grass clumps, and its tail hangs at one side. The coloring sheet contrasts the fox's open body shapes with the insect's segmented legs and narrow blades.

pages.title: Fox Watching a Butterfly Perched on Its Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox watches a butterfly on its nose in this printable coloring page, sitting upright with its muzzle raised and its bushy tail curled beside its paws. Leafy shoots, grass, and small stones surround the seated pose. This coloring sheet adds patterned butterfly wings above the fox's broad chest and fine cheek tufts.

pages.title: Fox Sniffing Bluebells Growing Beside a Woodland Path Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a fox sniffing bluebells beside a woodland path, lowering its nose toward hanging blossoms while its tail rests behind its legs. Tall trunks, bushes, and curving trail edges frame the scene. The coloring sheet includes long flower stems and grass blades around the fox's larger fur sections.

pages.title: Fox Exploring a Patch of Mushrooms Around an Old Tree Stump Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox explores mushrooms around a tree stump in this printable coloring page, stepping toward spotted caps with its head lowered and its bushy tail raised. Visible gills line the underside of the largest mushroom beside the cut stump. This coloring sheet pairs wide fur areas with small cap spots, bark lines, and scattered grass.

pages.title: Fox Emerging From a Hollow Fallen Log Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a fox emerging from a hollow fallen log, placing its front paws on the grass beneath pointed ears and a fluffy chest. The log's circular opening surrounds its body, with bark lines running along the wood. The coloring sheet provides broad animal shapes and smaller knots, leaves, and stones nearby.

pages.title: Fox Meeting a Hedgehog on a Leaf-covered Forest Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox meets a hedgehog on a leaf-covered trail in this printable coloring page, looking down as the smaller animal raises its nose beside the fox's paws. Tall trees and bushes border the forest path. The coloring sheet includes large fallen leaves in the foreground, with finer hedgehog spines and fox fur around the two faces.

pages.title: Fox Looking Up at an Owl Perched on a Low Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a fox looking up at an owl on a low branch, with the perched bird gazing down above the fox's raised muzzle. Lobed leaves surround the curved branch and textured trunk. The coloring sheet combines the fox's broad body and tail with smaller feather patterns, claws, leaves, and grass tufts.

pages.title: Fox Watching a Duck Lead Her Ducklings Across a Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox watches a duck leading three ducklings across a pond in this printable coloring page, standing on the grassy bank above the swimming family. Curved ripples surround the birds, and lily pads sit near the reeds. This coloring sheet adds small water lines and feather shapes around the fox's larger outlined body.

pages.title: Fox Balancing on a Fallen Tree Above a Shallow Stream Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a fox balancing on a fallen tree above a shallow stream, stepping along the trunk with its head turned toward the bank. Rounded rocks interrupt the water beneath the log, while shrubs and trees fill the distance. The coloring sheet includes varied bark marks, thin ripples, and broad fur sections.

pages.title: Fox Sheltering From the Rain Beneath a Spreading Oak Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox shelters beneath a spreading oak in this printable coloring page, sitting against its trunk with its tail curled beside it while raindrops fall beyond the branches. Acorns and lobed leaves fill the canopy overhead. This coloring sheet provides small leaf and rain shapes around the fox's larger open chest, body, and tail.

pages.title: Fox Watching Fireflies Above a Summer Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a fox watching fireflies above a summer meadow, sitting among flowers with its head tilted toward the insects and tail curled beside it. Small lines surround the flying fireflies, while daisylike blossoms rise around the fox. The coloring sheet combines open animal shapes with numerous petals, leaves, and narrow grass blades.

pages.title: Fox Standing on a Rocky Hill Beneath a Full Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox stands on a rocky hill beneath a full moon in this printable coloring page, turning its head beside a thick chest ruff and sweeping tail. A large circular moon hangs above the fox in the open sky. The coloring sheet includes angular rock cracks and sparse grass below the animal's broad body areas.

pages.title: Fox Chasing Windblown Autumn Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a fox chasing windblown autumn leaves, bounding forward with lifted paws, a raised tail, and its gaze angled toward a drifting leaf. Curved motion lines follow the leaves above the fox. The coloring sheet leaves the background open, with scattered ground leaves and grass adding smaller shapes around the running pose.

pages.title: Fox Peeking Between Pumpkins in a Pumpkin Patch Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox peeks between pumpkins in this printable coloring page, with its pointed ears, smiling face, and upright tail rising above the curling vines and leaves. pages.title: Fox Scratching Behind One Ear with a Hind Paw Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a fox scratching behind one ear with a raised hind paw, sitting upright beside its broad tail and looking to one side. Its front paws stay planted beneath the fluffy chest. The coloring sheet leaves the background blank, emphasizing the bent leg, pointed ears, facial features, and open body areas.

pages.title: Fox Shaking Water From Its Fur Beside a Puddle Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox shakes water from its fur beside a puddle in this printable coloring page, closing its eyes as droplets and curved motion marks surround its head. More outlined drops hang around the fox's body and tail. The coloring sheet includes broad fur sections above the puddle, with small grass tufts and scattered water shapes below.

pages.title: Winter Fox Wearing a Knitted Scarf Beside a Snowman Coloring Page

pages.title: Christmas Fox Wearing a Santa Hat Beside Wrapped Presents Coloring Page

pages.title: Halloween Fox Wearing a Witch Hat Beside a Jack-o-lantern Coloring Page

pages.title: Valentine Fox Sitting with a Heart Nestled Between Its Front Paws Coloring Page

The heart rests low against the fox's paws beneath its fluffy chest. This coloring sheet has a blank background and broad open areas within the body and heart.

pages.title: Easter Fox Sniffing Decorated Eggs in a Woven Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features an Easter fox sniffing decorated eggs in a woven basket, lowering its muzzle to the curved handle while its tail points upward. pages.title: Nine-tailed Fox Standing Among Swirling Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: A nine-tailed fox stands among swirling clouds in this printable coloring page, with its many long tails fanning upward behind pointed ears and a thick chest ruff.
